curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Double-crossed by his own employers, can a conscience-stricken hitman trust the rogue officer hunting him long enough to settle the score?
curatedMovie.description: After inadvertently blinding nightclub singer Jennie during a contract hit, elite mob assassin Jeffrey takes a final dangerous job to fund her surgery, only to face betrayal and form an uneasy alliance with a rogue cop.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, emotionally heavy, and suspenseful; an urgent Hong Kong crime drama demanding engaged attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by John Woo, this 1989 Hong Kong thriller blends kinetic action and sharp suspense with the heavy moral weight of sacrifice and professional honor.
